name: @gitbutler/but-ui
description: Design tokens, fonts and base styles for GitButler applications

scripts.build: node scripts/postprocess-light-dark.mjs && node scripts/check-style-vars.mjs && node scripts/check-presets.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/generate-ramps.mjs --check && node scripts/check-ramps.mjs && pnpm build && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- tokens/tokens.css tokens/settings.json tokens/tokens.json tokens/accent-samples.json
